open.invite: Drop a demo here, or click to choose one
open.hint: Recorded demos are kept in your match history folder.

progress.label: Reading progress
progress.hiddenTab: This tab spent time in the background. Browsers give a hidden tab far less processor time, so reading a demo there takes several times longer — keep this tab in front until it finishes.

cache.storing: Saving it for the next visit.
cache.unavailable: Not saved on this device. Opening it again will read the whole demo.

saved.title: On this device
saved.note: Opened before, kept in this browser. Removing one clears the saved copy — the .dem file on your disk is untouched.

gone.title: That demo is no longer on this device.
gone.hint: The browser cleared it, or the cache made room for a newer one. Open the file again to read it.

dialog.label: Saved match on {map}
dialog.plate: Round {round, number}, as the buy ends

shell.empty: Nothing here yet. A demo you open is kept on this device and appears here.

soonNote.lineups: Every grenade thrown in the match, grouped by where it was thrown from and where it landed. Not built yet.
soonNote.stats: What each player did across the match — opening duels, trades, utility, damage. Not built yet.

grid.cacheTotal: These demos take {used, number} MB of the {limit, number} MB this app keeps.
grid.estimate: Your browser estimates {used, number} MB in use for this site, out of about {quota, number} MB.
grid.persistence: The browser may clear this cache to make room. A demo it clears is read from the file again.

samples.title: Matches to try
samples.note: A professional match, ready to open — no demo of your own needed. Opening one downloads it once and keeps it on this device, where you can remove it like any other.
samples.open: Open {home} against {away} on {map}, downloading {megabytes, number, ::.#} MB

gone.title: That match could not be downloaded.
gone.hint: The connection dropped, or this build no longer serves it. Try again, or open a demo of your own.
